slug: 2025-12-15 Gambia launches BANTABA 2.0, first real-time interoperable payment system

facts.fact: The Point says BANTABA 2.0 lets funds move instantly between accounts across banks, mobile money operators, fintechs and public institutions regardless of provider.

The Point says BANTABA 2.0 is a national backbone connecting banks, mobile money operators, MFIs, fintechs and PSPs through a single interoperable switch with real-time clearing and settlement, operated by Gamswitch after a pilot.
The Point reports Wave Gambia's mobile money platform now lets passengers pay Gambia Transport Service Company bus fares through the Wave app, launched 19 June 2025.

slug: 2026-03-02 Gambia Gov't payments now digitalised live on Yonna Wallet app

facts.fact: The Yonna Wallet app, run by Yonna Group with over 200 branches and outlets, is live for payments in The Gambia, per The Standard.

The Central Bank of The Gambia says fintech and mobile money services have 5.4 million registered users and 2.9 million active users, with cash-in up 16.4 percent to D23.9 billion and cash-out up 19.6 percent to D25.8 billion between September and December 2025.
The release says BANTABA 2.0, the country's first real-time, fully interoperable payment system, has been launched, providing the backbone for instant digital payments.
The release says BANTABA 2.0 allows instant transfers between bank accounts and mobile wallets, and funds to move between accounts regardless of provider.

The release says BANTABA 2.0 connects banks, mobile money operators, microfinance institutions, fintechs and PSPs through a single interoperable switch, live after a pilot, with further institutions to join.
